title: Reengineering the next era of luxury
body: The global luxury ecosystem is undergoing a fundamental transformation, moving beyond conventional paradigms of ownership, exclusivity and status towards hyper-personalisation, intelligent services and immersive experiences. Despite rapid market evolution, significant gaps persist in how luxury is conceptualised, delivered, accessed and sustained. From fragmented consumer journeys and underdeveloped experiential ecosystems to inefficient service infrastructure and evolving expectations of affluent consumers, the industry presents substantial opportunities for disruption. How might we leverage emerging business models, technological innovation and unconventional value propositions to architect the next generation of luxury products, services and experiences, transforming premium living into an entirely new market opportunity?

title: Fast-moving consumer goods
body: The FMCG industry is undergoing a significant transformation as consumers increasingly demand healthier products, greater transparency, sustainability, personalized experiences, and seamless product availability. However, many companies continue to struggle with understanding rapidly changing consumer preferences, optimizing supply chains, reducing product wastage, ensuring efficient last-mile distribution, and building trust through authentic and transparent practices. Design an innovative startup that addresses one or more of these interconnected challenges to help FMCG businesses become more consumer-centric, operationally efficient, sustainable, and future-ready.

title: Clean energy and power
body: The energy transition is reshaping how power is produced, stored, distributed and used. Rooftop solar, electric mobility, batteries and smart grids are growing fast, yet customers find clean energy costly and confusing, grids struggle with peak demand and outages, hardware supply chains are fragile, and businesses cannot measure or reduce their emissions with confidence. Design an innovative startup that makes clean energy cheaper, more reliable, easier to adopt or easier to measure, for homes, businesses, farms or cities, while remaining commercially viable without permanent subsidies.

title: Reimagining the future of aviation
body: The global aviation industry is undergoing a fundamental transformation, with rising operational complexities, evolving passenger expectations, infrastructure constraints and growing sustainability concerns challenging traditional business models. From inefficiencies across airport operations and fragmented passenger experiences to gaps in accessibility, resource utilisation and emerging aviation services, the industry presents significant opportunities for innovation. Your challenge: identify an untapped opportunity or an existing inefficiency within the aviation ecosystem and develop an innovative product, service or business solution that redefines how the industry operates, serves its customers or creates value. Your solution may address any part of the aviation value chain, including passenger experience, airport infrastructure, airline operations, logistics, sustainability, aviation technology or emerging mobility models. Think beyond conventional aviation solutions. Objective: build an MVP that addresses a meaningful industry gap while demonstrating a clear value proposition, target market and potential for real-world adoption. How might we leverage disruptive innovation, emerging business models and unconventional solutions to redefine aviation, unlock untapped market opportunities and engineer the next generation of air travel?

title: Financial services
body: The financial services industry is undergoing a rapid digital transformation as consumers and businesses increasingly expect seamless payments, personalized financial solutions, instant access to credit, enhanced security, and greater financial transparency. However, millions of individuals and businesses continue to face challenges such as limited access to formal financial services, financial fraud, inefficient lending processes, low financial literacy, fragmented financial management, regulatory compliance complexities, and growing cybersecurity risks. At the same time, financial institutions struggle to leverage emerging technologies while maintaining customer trust, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Design an innovative startup that addresses one or more of these interconnected challenges to help create a more accessible, secure, intelligent, and inclusive financial ecosystem while delivering measurable value to consumers, businesses, and financial institutions.
